title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：shame　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shame 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the elder ① felt the shame that no youth in the village would have described, and he said the feeling was the whole of the year. The ② shame, meaning the disgrace itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; shame, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ bit of shame in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ shame at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Shame, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the elder said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shame was the whole of the matter, meaning the regret and not the disgrace. The ⑥ shame, meaning the regret and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; shame, he said, is either something you feel or the only word that means both disgrace and a regret. He said the regret is the part they remember.

By 1993 the ⑦ shame had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ shame of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of describing; shame, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shame I remember is the shame described in the memoir, which closed in 1995 and is still described as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Shame, my mother said in 1997, is the only thing that improves by being described; all shame, she said, is a regret that has agreed to look like disgrace. She said the regret was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 羞耻；遗憾（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 羞耻；遗憾（指那分羞耻本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：feel the shame 感到这一分羞耻
D. n. 羞耻；遗憾（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 羞耻之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的羞耻之事）
F. n. 羞耻；遗憾（指回忆录里写到、被描述的那一分）
G. n. 羞耻、愧疚（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 愧疚（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: felt the shame that no youth in the village would have described
The shame, meaning the disgrace itself and not the staff
Every bit of shame in that village
the shame at the far gate
the shame was the whole of the matter
the shame had become a line in a memoir
The shame of the whole thing

answers.why: feel the shame 意为“感到这一分羞耻”，1988 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯描述的一分羞耻做了一遍。
shame 意为“羞耻；遗憾”，指那分羞耻本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
shame 意为“羞耻；遗憾”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
shame 意为“羞耻；遗憾”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shame 意为“羞耻、愧疚”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分愧疚就是那件事的全部。
shame 意为“愧疚”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分羞耻，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shame 意为“羞耻；遗憾”，指回忆录里写到、被描述的那一分，到 1993 年这一分成了回忆录里的一行。
shame 意为“羞耻之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的羞耻之事是一处村子和三个年头的描述。
shame 意为“羞耻；遗憾”，我记得的是回忆录里描述过的那一分，1995 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一分。
shame 为抽象总称，母亲 1997 年说，羞耻是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的羞耻。
